integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. a small military vehicle-wash bay of riveted grey steel plates. Wet grey concrete floor, two faded yellow safety lines, one rectangular drain hole at centre with the grate lying face down beside it, red-wheel water valves and a coiled hose reel on the left wall, electric cabinets and a broom on the right wall, two stacked steel drums at rear right, a white canvas curtain on a ceiling rail at the back, a bare chain with a hook above the drain, two caged industrial lamps hanging from the riveted steel ceiling. The bay is fully ENCLOSED: the riveted steel ceiling spans the entire top of frame and solid steel walls close every side - no sky, no clouds, no windows, no daylight openings anywhere; when the camera looks up it sees only the steel ceiling, the caged lamps and the chain. Cool hard overhead light, short shadows, wet surfaces. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. The camera stays at chest height the whole time and never tilts up; the riveted steel ceiling and the caged lamps stay visible across the top of the frame in every shot - the bay is closed and has no openings. AT START: On the left, a partially visible figure in a red-and-black plaid shirt, suspenders, and tan trousers stands on white cushions holding a dark bakelite telephone handset with a coiled cord, while on the right a figure in a tan cable-knit sweater, green trousers, and beige clogs holds a small red object in his right hand; between them are a low metal device with an upright handle, white material, dark boards, and a black puddle, with coiled hoses on the left wall, a hanging hook above, a rusty barrel and broom on the right, and shallow water reflecting across the floor beside a yellow line.. [Shot 1] Close insert of the steel hook swinging gently on its chain, JUCA's fist closing on the links at the bottom of the frame and jamming a YELLOW carpenter pencil through the hook eye like a pin, the riveted steel wall and a caged lamp filling the background behind the hook. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to a wide shot: JUCA hauls the chain down hand over hand and the steel drum swings up and slams flat against the underside of the riveted steel ceiling plate that stays visible across the top of the frame, dust and paint flakes dropping from the ceiling seam, while TEO shoves both palms up under it and pushes. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot at chest height: TEO grips the hanging drum with both hands and pulls, and his own boots come up off the wet floor while JUCA holds the chain still with one hand and shrugs; the steel wall and the caged lamps stay behind them. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: steel drum jammed flat against the ceiling plate on the chain; TEO hanging from the drum with his boots off the wet floor; the yellow carpenter pencil still pinned through the hook eye.
overall_soundscape: The chain rasps through the hook and the steel drum clangs against the ceiling plate, then the chain creaks under a new weight. TEO grunts once. JUCA whistles two low flat notes.
